fuel_estimate.description: Offline Testing, flags 0x10000200, 0.45 L per lap from a 70 L tank, eight ticks per lap, 3 s apart. The lap counter changes: the first leaves a part-observed lap, the second and third each complete a clean lap with a fuel sample, so fuel_laps_remaining and fuel_hard_limit_laps first appear on the third change (SDK Lap 3).
